portal_description:
Red Hat Build of Apache Camel for Quarkus 3.2.0 is now available (updates to RHBQ 3.2.6.SP1).  The purpose of this text-only errata is to inform you about the enhancements that improve your developer  experience and ensure the security and stability of your products:
   * CXF SAML Security unit test hangs if the client is configured incorrectly. 
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-xml-jaxp
   * netty-http generate always IllegalReferenceCountException for every success request.
   * Camel-cxf DefaultCxfBinding throws ClassCastException when invoking extractInvocationContextFromCamel method
   * update CEQ migration instructions with camel-cxf-soap namespace changes
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-netty-http
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-grpc
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-mybatis
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-minio
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-crypto
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-ldap
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-vertx-websocket
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-xslt-saxon
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-mapstruct
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-micrometer
   * OpenAPI contract does not define request body if no content-type is specified in the Camel REST DSL.
   * camel-core - Route template with hardcoded node IDs - Allow to specify prefix
   * JMS components connection pooling (generic client, full support)
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-splunk
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-management
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-language
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-azure-servicebus
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-aws2-cw
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-telegram
   * Support extension: camel-quarkus-sap
